title: Te Tākinga pātaka
authors: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes; not a source copy.

passages.note: Te Papa identifies Te Tākinga as a pātaka carved by Te Hārete Te Whanarere, Ngāti Makino, around 1850 and originally at Te Hape, Lake Rotoiti. It describes its importance to Ngāti Pikiao, later acquisition and restoration. The catalogue does not identify the particular contents originally stored.
